queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT link_to_event
FROM r
ORDER BY ratio / (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent * 1.0 / amount) AS event_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event);
SELECT AVG(spent * 1.0 / amount) FROM budget WHERE amount <> 0
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(spent) / AVG(amount) AS ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event)
SELECT SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) FROM budget WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL;
